candidates.options: Full original FP8 weights distributed in host RAM with bounded GPU expert/weight cache; genuine microbatch pipeline overlap acrossVMs.

candidates.risks: Preserve FP8 storage; expanding all weights to BF16/FP32 would exceed host RAM. PCIe transfer/cache misses, large per-stage activation/KV memory and low-throughput prefills may make customer latency unacceptable.

conclusion: Existing quota prevents proposed16A100 all-GPU configuration, not every full-model option. Smaller VM counts can rise but totalVRAM remains insufficient for originalFP8 in reviewed candidates. Investigate weight-preserving host offload first for multiVM constraint; compare single8A100 NVLink/offload for efficiency. Treat4bit T4 as separate conversion/quality project.
